description:
Job Summary
Autumn lake Healthcare at Cherry Lane is looking for a qualified RN nursing unit manager to oversee patients and manage the nursing team in our facility. Our ideal candidate has solid experience as a registered nurse and is able to handle stressful situations. This position requires team management skills and a problem-solving attitude. Further training in management or administration would be a bonus. Ultimately, you should be able to ensure smooth nursing operation at our facility through day-to-day management and long term planning.
Duties

Supervise nursing staff, providing guidance, support, and performance evaluations.
Ensure adherence to established protocols and standards of care within the unit or facility.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to develop and implement effective discharge planning for patients.
Oversee patient care activities in critical care settings, including Level II trauma center operations.
Manage acute pain management strategies for patients, ensuring appropriate interventions are in place.
Facilitate health coaching initiatives to promote wellness and recovery among patients.
Maintain accurate documentation in electronic health records systems such as Cerner.
Provide specialized care for patients with dementia and those requiring assisted living services.
Coordinate home care services as needed to support patient transitions from hospital to home environments.
Etc.

Job Requirements

Active Registered Nurse licensure without disciplinary infractions by Maryland Board of Nursing.
BSN desired
1-2 years of management experience.
Knowledge and proficiency with COMAR, OHCQ and CMS guidelines a plus.
Short term and long term experience preferred




Job Type: Full-time


Pay: $95,000.00 – $100,000.00 per year


Benefits:


401(k)
Dental insurance
Employee discount
Flexible schedule
Health insurance
Life insurance
Paid holidays
Paid sick time
Paid time off
Referral program
Vision insurance

 
Schedule:


8 hour shift
Monday to Friday
Weekends as needed

 


Work Location: In person

description:
Autumn Lake Healthcare at Cherry Lane is seeking full-time, part-time, and PRN GNAs. The candidates must be devoted and compassionate about their chosen career and have an active certification. We are looking for GNAs who are dependable, self-motivated, team player, and flexible.
Works throughout the nursing service area (i.e. nurses’ stations, resident rooms, etc.)

Must have active GNA license in MD.
Moves intermittently during working hours.
Is subject to frequent interruptions.
Is involved with residents, personnel, visitors, government agencies/personnel, etc., under all conditions and circumstances
Is subject to hostile and emotionally upset residents, family members, personnel, and visitors.
Communicates with nursing personnel and other department personnel.
Works beyond normal working hours, on weekends and holidays, and in other positions temporarily, when necessary.
Is subject to call-back during emergency conditions (e.g. severe weather, evacuation, post-disaster, etc.).
Attends and participates in continuing educational programs.
Is subject to injury from falls, burns from equipment, odors, etc., throughout the work day, as well as to reactions from dust, disinfectants, tobacco smoke and other air contaminants.
Is subject to exposure to infectious waste, diseases, conditions, etc., including TB, and the AIDS and Hepatitis B virus.
May be subject to the handling and exposure to hazardous chemicals.

Benefits:

Dental insurance
Flexible schedule
Health insurance
Life insurance
Paid time off
Vision insurance
